question: Two subsets $A$ and $B$ of the $(x,y)$-plane are said to be equivalent if there exists a function $f:A\to B$ which is both one-to-one and onto. (i) Show that any two line segments in the plane are equivalent. (ii) Show that any two circles in the plane are equivalent.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
